name: secure-centric/section-explainer
title: Section Explainer
description: Explainer section introducing core defense compliance regulations and boundaries.

p1.default: CMMC (Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification) is the Department of War standard ensuring defense subcontractors safeguard Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

p2.default: Under 32 CFR Part 170 and DFARS 252.204-7021, all contractors handling CUI must achieve Level 2 compliance against the 110 requirements of NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 before contract award.

p3.default: Our Cyber AB Registered Practitioners conduct on-site facility walkthroughs, map exact CUI boundaries, guide technical remediation, and co-author your assessor-ready System Security Plan (SSP).
